## How the classes work

Sessions 1 to 4 have the same rhythm: a 45-minute framework block, a 2-hour guided build on your team's own product with a short break, a 45-minute critique, and a 30-minute milestone review. Session 5 is Demo Day. The class page is the framework block and the lab guide in one place. Read it before the session (90 to 100 minutes); during the session you will spend most of the time building.

The simulators are safe to play with. The practice questions explain why each wrong option is wrong. The lab checklist is saved in your browser, so you can come back to it between sessions.

## Support pages

| Page | When you need it |
|---|---|
| [Toolkit setup guide](setup.html) | Before session 1 (accounts) and before session 2 (repository, database, hosting, keys) |
| [Security checklist](security-checklist.html) | Before session 4: fourteen checks to run on your own app |
| [Rubric](rubric.html) | Before every milestone and before Demo Day |

One rule applies from the first minute. Until your team has completed the session 4 lab, closed every critical finding, and has the written agreement of the organization that owns the data, use only invented or de-identified information: no real names, phone numbers, addresses or tax numbers. Most teams will stay with de-identified data through Demo Day, and that costs nothing in the grade.

## What you will have used by the end

| Building block | What it is for | Where you practice it |
|---|---|---|
| Prompt and brief | Saying what you want precisely enough to be built | Class 1 |
| Web page and web app | Something a real user opens in a browser | Classes 1 and 2 |
| Project instructions | Stop repeating conventions in every conversation | Class 2 |
| Skill | Make "how we do it here" repeatable | Class 2 |
| Connector (MCP) | Give the assistant scoped access to company systems | Classes 2 and 4 |
| Agent | Let a model take steps, with your approval | Class 3 |
| Automation | Work that starts on a schedule or an event | Class 3 |
| Presentation | A deck generated from your evidence, verified by you | Class 5 |
